notes.title: 20.000 wishlists and 5.000 demo players!
notes.content:
Hello travelers to Yariv,[p align="start"]
Thank you for 20.000 wishlists! More and more people want to explore the vast world of Verho, and 5.000 demo players have already taken a glimpse of it! 
Since we reached this milestone, we want to share with you some special news: 

We will be part of the Steam Next Fest in October with a unique demo! 
This version will contain:

4 pre-made characters, each with their own powerful weapons and mighty spells

Brand new locations with new creatures, unique enemies, and dangerous bosses

A blade shining in the moonlight....     
[p align="start"]It will be available only for a limited time, so remember to check out our Steam page during the Next Fest 13. - 20 October. 



Thank you again for your support in the Steam reviews, but especially in our Discord server. 
We will also share an exclusive invitation in the server before the Next Fest, so if you haven't joined yet, this is your chance: https://discord.com/invite/drJzkyDeBa


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048979/77ca3fc903d4c408379f437bfebc27957ed56dbd.jpg"]

notes.title: The Curse of Faces arrives at gamescom
notes.content:
Hello travelers to Yariv, Our team has great news to share: 
We are exhibiting at gamescom Cologne! If you are planning to be there, you have one mission: 
Find the CobraTekku Games booth in hall 10.2 at the HOME of INDIES group booth.



This will be your reward: 

Chance to play a unique gamescom version with never-before-seen weapons, enemies and bosses

Loot some limited merchandise

Have a friendly chat with the team behind the game



If you can't attend gamescom, don't worry: Maybe you haven't played our updated demo, so give it a try! And if you already did that, perhaps you want to start a new character - some of our Discord community members already reached level 100 with their characters, so what is your excuse? 



We are looking forward to meeting you all! 





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048979/c337bbceec261c0b68d71df73084a604d8c22a27.jpg"]

notes.title: BIG DEMO UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello travelers to Yariv, 


As we work on the main game, we are implementing numerous improvements and moving closer to our final vision. 

However, we don't want to keep it from you, so we've decided to update the demo and give you a small glimpse of our work behind the scenes. 


The new demo contains: 
New Content --------------------------------------------------------------

Reworked texture for almost every object in the game!

New and more polished tutorial (Black and White Forest)

New tree models in the forest area 

Improvements ------------------------------------------------------------

Improvements to Mask Altar UI 

Better scrolling in menus with the mouse scroll 

Better display of shield's passive defence in inventory 

Changes ------------------------------------------------------------------- 

Broken Sword received a damage and reach buff 

Barrels' durability changed: 150HP --> 70HP 

Burn and poison deal more damage to enemies 

Glitches ------------------------------------------------------------------- 

Brawler ring HP decrease bug fixed 

More minor bug fixes



Play the new demo for yourself and let us know what you think - either as a Steam review or in our active Discord: https://discord.com/invite/drJzkyDeBa



I wish you great adventures in Yariv! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048979/2f3fbb78ba80f3c46c4a3d0049622a8236b216f9.jpg"]

notes.title: 10.000 Wishlist Milestone
notes.content:
Hello travelers to Yariv,


Many of you have already explored the first areas of Yariv and the secrets it holds in our demo. 

But you want more...more than 10.000 of you Wishlisters want to see more of this accursed land. You want to fight against stronger creatures, learn more about this world and its inhabitants, and make powerful weapons and spells your own. 

And for that we want to say THANK YOU! 



10.000 wishlists is a great milestone and the number is growing every day. 

If you want to join us on our journey, see how we improve the game, and talk with other travelers, you should join our very active Discord! 


https://discord.com/invite/drJzkyDeBa



And if you haven't already, be sure to wishlist Verho and leave a follow so you can stay up to date. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048979/944b5ac3b312d37952b34b51e9d71adf878d331b.png"]

notes.title: 2.000 players already explored the dark lands of Yariv
notes.content:
Hello travelers to Yariv, 

We reached a big milestone: More than 2,000 players played the demo of Verho, and we want to say THANK YOU!

All your support and feedback help us refine the game even further. If you've already played the demo, it would be great if you could leave a review on the Steam demo page. This way, other players will know what to expect, and we can learn from your experience in the cursed land of Yariv.

You should also join our very active Discord to talk with the dev team and other like-minded players. 
https://discord.com/invite/drJzkyDeBa

Keep an eye on this page, as we'll announce another big news soon!

notes.title: Thanks for 4k wishlist and Happy 2025!
notes.content:
Happy 2025 everyone! 

Today Verho reached 4k wishlists and it's amazing because just 7 days ago we were celebrating 3k.
I wanted to thank you all and for the first time announce that the demo will receive a new update at the end of January.

Here is what the new update for demo will include:


 New Npc with a new quest that will change early progression a bit.
 Graphical improvement is in most areas, the biggest one being in Rotten Valley.
 Change a lot of bloom, for the rotten Valley, and YES, torch too!
 Galecrasher will receive a new longer description and Sword Magic which will be its special attack.
 New Ambient sounds to each area.
 Some new descriptions and spelling mistakes will be fixed.


When it comes to how full game development is going

I would say it's going pretty well. If you're interested in seeing daily updates, you can join our Discord server, where you can talk with developers daily and see full game progression in real time!

Discord Link: https://discord.gg/4x8S893eYq

notes.title: Demo Updates 27-29.3 Change Log
notes.content:
Here are some changes from 3 post-lunch updates of the demo!
Let me know how you like it, and if you want to talk with me or other members of community be sure to join verho Discord Server! 
https://discord.gg/4x8S893eYq

Change log:


Improvements


 New Hanger’s Sounds 
 New Footstpes Sounds 
 In game keyboard for name input field while playing on gamepad
 More Visible inactive Mask Altars
 Weak spell sooner in the game
 More Visible Manual
 Fall damage nerf
 Abillity to use Usable items from inventory
 Smaller Contact Hitboxes
 Worms and Bat Damaging only if chagring on to player
 Easier jumps in Red Cavern
 UI Mouse Controll
 Loading Screens
 New Credits
 Pixel Effect can be now disabled in options
 Head anim can be now disabled in options
 Optional Crosshair
 Invincibility Frames while traveling and resting
 Crouch lock
 Smother Crouch
 Player can no longer crouch in air
 Minor changes to Red Cavern layout
 Yariv pass changed
 Corrupted Core more visible animation
 Some Spelling Mistakes (All from discord server not counting ones in Manual)
 Modified background in Temple to match future location
 New Easter in Nameless Village



System Changes

New Enemies Resitst System
    [Old Systeam ]
All enemies had weakness +50% dmg, resistance -50% dmg, immunity -100% dmg
  [New System]
All enemies have a value of -100% to 300% to all elements damage types
Also, all weapons have no Slashing, Blunt, or Thrust damage and all enemies have unique         
esistance.


Balance

 Better Shields, now give passive Defence and can cancel end of attack animation.
 Poisoned Biters are now a bit slower


Gliches


 Temple Outdoor, stone path missing hitbox fixe
 Save not saving last level up
 Pressing Esc while Rotten Valley cutscene froze the game
 Some hints have End, and should Esc
 Invisible Ladder Fixed
 Drop from Giant Worm, can’t glitch anymore
 Hunger pathfinding fixed in portal room
 Fixed wrong name in last note from Kurath City [Perantius(snake name) -> Azarion(correct name)]
 Barrels no sound while not hitting directly fixed
 Spear Elemental Buff Fixed
 Voices volume always set on value of Sounds Fixed
 Cannot move while blocking on Controller Fixes
 Softlock while unlocking 1st mask altar without resting
